Context: Pick a platform she can demo without engineering help. You care about: time-to-first-agent, templates, pricing clarity, onboarding, numbers.

JOURNEY 2/5: Knowledge support — KB + boundaries + escalation
BASELINE: Open an EXISTING agent/assistant/pathway first (do not create a new one). If the account has zero agents, stop on the empty list/create CTA and report that baseline is missing — do not invent a full create flow for journeys 2–5.
USER GOAL: Start from an EXISTING baseline agent/assistant/pathway (open the first usable one in the list — do not create a brand-new agent from scratch). When done, in your final answer include: (1) what you accomplished, (2) 2–4 things you LIKED about Vapi's UX for this journey, (3) 2–4 things you DISLIKED or found confusing, (4) how hard this felt (easy/medium/hard), (5) whether you used a template/AI assist (yes/no).
runs.judge_reason: The Vapi product console at https://dashboard.vapi.ai/ consistently failed to load, displaying only a black screen with a loading indicator. The agent made multiple attempts to wait and re-navigate, but the page never loaded successfully. Consequently, the agent could not access any existing agents, configure knowledge base settings, or escalation behaviors, and thus could not complete the task.
runs.judge_evidence: The final screenshot shows a black screen with a loading indicator, indicating the page did not load successfully.
